paragraphs.html: After working with both platforms, our group concluded that Proxmox is the better choice for our use case. It has a more modern and intuitive interface, is easier to set up and manage, and being fully open-source means no licensing costs. VMware is the industry standard and remains powerful, but for a student or home-lab environment, Proxmox delivers everything you need with less friction.
